trace_observations.description: Agent loaded device-operator via skill_read before operating the phone UI (informational only).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the system Settings app from home screen.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Settings app main page (header text or recognisable layout).
No crash dialog or error overlay is visible in the post-screenshot.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the Clock app from the home screen.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Clock app (alarm/world clock/timer tabs visible).
No crash dialog or error overlay is visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must navigate back from a settings sub-page to the parent settings page.

setup.prompt: 先打开系统设置，进入一个有返回按钮的子页面（比如 Wi-Fi、蓝牙、关于手机之类），然后停在那个子页面。

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the parent or top-level Settings page after leaving the settings sub-page visible in the pre-screenshot.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must locate a search input on the screen and type the literal string 'hello' into it.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows a focused text input (cursor or filled field).
The string 'hello' appears in the visible input field.
No unrelated typed characters appear before/after 'hello'.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must perform a vertical scroll downward on the current page.

setup.prompt: 先打开系统设置，停在设置列表靠上的位置，别进具体设置项。

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows lower content from the same settings list than the pre-screenshot, consistent with one downward scroll.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must swipe horizontally on the home screen to switch to a different home screen page.
tasks.prompt: 在桌面左右滑动，切到下一页。

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows a different home-screen page than the pre-screenshot.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the notification shade by swiping down from the top of the screen.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the notification shade pulled down (system toggles or notifications visible).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open Settings, find the search box, search for 蓝牙, and end on the Bluetooth settings page.
tasks.prompt: 打开系统设置，搜索「蓝牙」并进入蓝牙设置页面。

rubric.check: Agent navigated into Settings at some step (visible in trace screenshots).
Agent typed 蓝牙 into a search field.
Post-screenshot shows the Bluetooth settings page (Bluetooth toggle and device list).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must turn Wi-Fi off from the Wi-Fi settings page.

setup.prompt: 先打开系统设置，进入 Wi-Fi 设置页面，并确保 Wi-Fi 当前是开着的，停在 Wi-Fi 页面。

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Wi-Fi settings page.
Post-screenshot shows Wi-Fi disabled or the Wi-Fi toggle in the off state.
No unrelated settings appear toggled.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must turn Wi-Fi on from the Wi-Fi settings page.

setup.prompt: 先打开系统设置，进入 Wi-Fi 设置页面，并确保 Wi-Fi 当前是关着的，停在 Wi-Fi 页面。

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Wi-Fi settings page.
Post-screenshot shows Wi-Fi enabled or the Wi-Fi toggle in the on state.
No unrelated settings appear toggled.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the Clock app, create a new alarm for 7:30, and save it.
tasks.prompt: 打开时钟应用，新建一个 7:30 的闹钟并保存。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent inside the Clock app.
Trace shows an alarm creation/time-picker UI.
Post-screenshot shows alarms list including a 7:30 entry.
The newly created alarm is shown as enabled (toggle on).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must repeatedly scroll a settings page until the bottom of the list is reached, and stop scrolling once the bottom is detected.

setup.prompt: 先打开系统设置，停在设置列表靠上的位置，别进具体设置项。

tasks.prompt: 在设置页面一直往下滑，滑到底为止。

rubric.check: Trace contains at least three swipe/scroll tool calls.
Post-screenshot shows the bottom area of the settings list rather than the same top or middle content visible in the pre-screenshot.
Agent's final reply indicates the bottom was reached or no more content.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must locate a text input and type the literal string 'Aiden test benchmark-2026!' into it.

setup.prompt: 先打开一个简单的记事类应用（比如 Notepad Free），新建一个空白文档，停在一个空白输入框里，什么都先别输入。

tasks.prompt: 在当前输入框里输入：Aiden test benchmark-2026!

rubric.check: Trace shows a focused text input.
Post-screenshot shows the literal text 'Aiden test benchmark-2026!' in the input.
No unrelated typed characters appear before or after the target text.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must clear an input field that already contains text by selecting all and deleting.

setup.prompt: 先打开一个简单的记事类应用，新建一条笔记，在输入框里输入 hello-aiden，保持文字可见。

tasks.prompt: 把输入框里已有的文字全部清空。

rubric.check: Trace shows a select-all action (META+A or equivalent).
Post-screenshot shows the input field is empty.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must type a phrase, select all and copy it, then move to a different input field and paste it.

setup.prompt: 先打开一个简单的记事类应用，准备一个同时能看到两个空白输入框的页面（比如笔记的标题框和正文框），两个输入框都保持为空。

tasks.prompt: 在第一个输入框输入 hello-aiden（输入前如果是中文输入法，先切到英文键盘），选中复制，再切到第二个输入框粘贴。

rubric.check: Trace shows hello-aiden being typed into an input.
Trace shows a copy action, either through a visible Android edit menu or a supported shortcut.
Trace shows agent moving to a different input field.
Post-screenshot shows hello-aiden in the second input field.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must navigate into Settings and scroll to find a specific item ('关于手机' / 'About phone'), then tap it.
tasks.prompt: 打开系统设置，往下找到「关于手机」并点进去。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent inside Settings.
Trace contains at least one scroll/swipe action inside Settings.
Post-screenshot shows the About-phone / device-info page.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must long-press a currently visible normal app icon on the home screen to trigger the contextual popup menu.
tasks.prompt: 长按桌面上一个普通的应用图标（别按天气/时间小组件、空白处、通知栏或底部导航），直到弹出操作菜单。

rubric.check: Trace contains a touch_gesture long_press action on a visible normal app icon area.
Post-screenshot shows a contextual popup menu or action overlay near the app icon.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must drag a currently visible normal app icon from its current position to a different location on the home screen. The icon should end up in a visibly different grid position.

setup.prompt: 回到桌面，选一个图标比较少的桌面页。

tasks.prompt: 选桌面上一个普通的应用图标（别选小组件、空白处、通知栏或底部导航），把它拖到另一个空白位置。

rubric.check: Trace shows agent took a screenshot and identified a visible normal app icon position.
Trace contains a touch_gesture drag action with start and end coordinates that differ significantly.
Post-screenshot shows the chosen app icon in a different grid position compared to the pre-screenshot.
